meaning.situation_summary: The learner eats lunch at work with only a banana in the bag and an empty plate; colleague Julio is at the bakery and messages to ask what the learner already has.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Answer Julio’s question with the bag contents and use his bakery visit to ask for bread.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Julio’s question exists so he knows what to buy; the banana answers it and the empty plate shows why bread is wanted. Every goal follows from his message.
meaning.contrivance_check: The bakery trip and Julio’s own question supply the reason for both goals. The coordinator wording Julio gaat nu naar de bakker. Hij vraagt left open whether he asked face to face, which would make a written reply odd; the reviewer made him already at the bakery and sending a message.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Julio is away at the bakery and writes first, so a written reply to him is the natural medium; he is not in the picture.
meaning.tone_reason: A colleague buying bread for lunch is ordinary workday routine.
meaning.final_source_recheck: Re-read the rebuilt final packet: prompt, picture (woman opening a brown bag with a yellow banana, empty blue plate) and alt agree.

meaning.situation_summary: The learner hosts a film evening at home tonight; the picture shows a white cloth between two garden trees with a projector, and friend Sabrina asks where and at what time.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Tell an invited friend the garden location seen in the picture and a start time the learner chooses.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Sabrina is a guest who is not there yet, so she needs both facts. Thuis makes the garden the learner’s own; the screen and projector make the outdoor setting clear without a clock or invented device.
meaning.contrivance_check: Location now comes from the picture rather than being printed in the prompt, and the time is the learner’s choice because the scene has no clock. The pictured woman (short curly hair, blue jumper) is unnamed and differs from cast Sabrina, so the learner is not texting someone who already sees the screen.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Sabrina asks two direct questions before the evening; a written answer to her is the obvious reply. She is not the person shown at the screen.
meaning.tone_reason: A home film night in the garden is a plausible leisure plan.
meaning.final_source_recheck: Re-read the rebuilt final packet: thuis, the garden screen and Sabrina’s two questions give each goal one source.
